description: Make a profile the account's default player profile ('Padrão'). Exclusive profiles cannot be default. If the current default profile has videos, ASK the user what happens to them and pass unlinked_videos_strategy: 'apply-new' = they follow the new default; 'keep-current' = they stay with the current profile. Without it only the default flag changes and no video is touched. Video changes run in the background (videoMigrationQueued). Returns {message, id, videoMigrationQueued}.

profile_id.description: Profile ID that becomes the default

unlinked_videos_strategy.description: What happens to the videos of the current default: 'apply-new' (follow the new default) or 'keep-current' (stay as they are)

name: panda_set_default_profile
title: Set Default Profile
